qualification.details: Candidates applying for CSIR NGRI Technician Recruitment 2026 must fulfill the essential qualification requirements mentioned for the respective trade. The minimum qualification includes SSC/10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks along with ITI Certificate, National/State Trade Certificate, apprenticeship experience, or relevant work experience. | Candidates should have SSC/10th Standard or equivalent qualification with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks along with any one of the following requirements: | ITI Certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the relevant trade. Three years of work experience in the relevant trade in a Ministry/Department/Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Body under Government of India, State Government, or Union Territory.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates for Technician Grade-II posts will receive salary under Level-02 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. | The posts also carry applicable allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA), medical benefits, Leave Travel Concession and other benefits as per CSIR/Government of India rules.

Candidates should have SSC/10th Standard or equivalent qualification with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks along with any one of the following requirements: ITI Certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the relevant trade. Three years of work experience in the relevant trade in a Ministry/Department/Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Body under Government of India, State Government, or Union Territory.
